statement: Open or create the default isometric 3D view with orbit, section box and visibility control.
superiority: Open huge models instantly with progressive loading of geometry.

acceptance.sketch: Default 3D view contains all visible model categories and a bounding box matches the model.

statement: Place a perspective camera with eye point, target point, height offset and field of view.
superiority: Adjust the camera live while viewing the plan with a floating preview.

acceptance.sketch: Camera view of a known box shows the expected perspective vanishing geometry.

statement: Define a camera path with keyframes and play or export a walkthrough animation.
superiority: Allow path editing in 3D with smooth spline and speed curves.

acceptance.sketch: Walkthrough has the set frame count and passes the keyframe positions.

acceptance.sketch: Section of a known wall shows the wall profile with the correct cut elevation.
